published_csv.line_terminator: CRLF (pandas' os.linesep default where the published file was written)
CRLF (pandas' os.linesep default where the published file was written)

extraction.filter: tools/oooi_pin_extract.keep: every label 2N and QP / QQ / QR / QS message, plus every message whose text names LFPG, LTFM or LIRF and has at least two 4-digit groups; tools/oooi_pin_pack.py keeps the first copy of each (label, flight, text) as messages_unique.parquet
extraction.month_rule: a file belongs to a month when its start date (from the file name) lies between the day before the month's first day and the month's last day (tools/oooi_pin_extract.month_window)
extraction.re_extraction_note: A new extraction lists the live GitHub releases; the receipts fix the file set used here (name, URL, size, SHA-256, line count per file). Its messages_unique.parquet may order copies with equal time stamps differently; the byte-for-byte check of v70 starts from the stored message tables, whose SHA-256 is recorded in docs/oooi_pin/results_v1.json (inputs_sha256.messages_dev / messages_fresh).
extraction.source: adsb.lol Aircraft Data Links archive, CC0 1.0: GitHub releases of adsblol/aircraft-data-links-2025 and adsblol/aircraft-data-links-2026 (zstd-compressed JSONL of ACARS, VDL2 and HFDL messages)
extraction.where: Azure arcw0 (Linux), 7 October 2026, with the repository's .venv and the zstd command-line tool; the raw archive is never stored: each file is downloaded into memory, hashed (SHA-256 of the compressed bytes), decompressed and filtered
extraction.worker_count: --workers (default 24) changes only the completion order of messages.jsonl, not the set of kept messages
